content: शङ्खः, -ङ्खम् [शम्-ख <ls>Uṇ. 1. 102</ls>] .²1 The conch-shell, a shell; न श्वेतभावमुज्झति शङ्खः शिखिमुक्तमुक्तोऽपि <ls>Pt. 4. 110</ls>; शङ्खान् दध्मुः पृथक् पृथक् <ls>Bg. 1. 18</ls>. .²2 The bone on the forehead; शङ्खान्तरद्योति विलोचनं यत् <ls>Ku. 7. 33</ls>; <ls>Rām. 6. 48. 10</ls>. .²3 The temporal bone. .²4 The part between the tusks of an elephant. .²5 A hundred billions. .²6 A military drum or other martial instrument. .²7 A kind of perfume (नखी). .²8 One of the nine treasures of Kubera. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon slain by Viṣṇu. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of the author of a Smṛti (mentioned in conjunction with लिखित <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²11 A bracelet (made of conchshell); अवघ्रन्त्याः प्रकोष्ठस्थाश्चक्रुः शङ्खाः स्वनं महत् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 9. 6</ls>.
